description: §51.0.F (S478; code name confirmed S479) — a QUOTED `rule=` target form on a state-child (`rule=".Loading"`) is E-ENGINE-RULE-QUOTED: the three forms are written unquoted.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 30 · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 2 (code name confirmed)
rationale: §51.0.F: "A `rule=` value written QUOTED on a state-child — a quoted target form … — is none of the three forms and is not an alias of one; it SHALL be `E-ENGINE-RULE-QUOTED` (Error)".
